Exact paint name not documented; early cars were offered in Speedster Blue, red and white. The factory colour charts of 1954 and 1955–59 list no Signalrot (it appears only from 1960); their reds are Türkischrot (5402) and Rubinrot (5702).

launchColor.name: Vipergrün Diamant (Viper Green Diamond)
launchColor.note: Series-production 911 Turbo 3.0 unveiled 3 Oct 1974 at the Paris Motor Show, "Painted in Viper Green Diamond" (Vipergrün-Diamant, code 249) with black leather and tartan seat centres, per Porsche's press kit "50 Years of Porsche Turbo". Not to be confused with the Porsche Museum's early Turbo 3.0 in Silver Green Diamond (Silbergrün-Diamant, code 250, "Ice Green Metallic"): one of the first 30 series cars, built 1975 for the French market, which the museum datasheet does not call the show car. The 1973 IAA study and the one-off for Louise Piëch (Aug 1974) were silver. Widerspruch: Porsche (Paint to Sample) schreibt, der 911 Turbo 3.0 (930) sei bekannt geworden, als er in Eichengrünmetallic vorgestellt wurde: https://media.porsche.com/paint-to-sample/en/911/oakgreenmetallic
